title: Tags input
description: Free-text tags in a field: Enter or a comma adds what's typed, a pasted list adds each item, Backspace removes the last, and each tag has its own remove button. Suggestions from the browser's own list, no duplicates in any case, an optional maximum, and a screen reader hears every change. Submits as name[] and works with Livewire wire:model.

consider.note: `max` and the suggestions only act in the browser: a request can send any number of tags, of any length. Cap both in your Form Request (`max:` on the array, and on each with `tags.*`), and drop duplicates in any case.

If each new tag becomes a row, typos and one-offs pile up and every tag list grows. Consider limiting tags to an allowlist (`Rule::in()` or `exists:`) where the set is known, or tidying unused tags with a scheduled job.
